title: Add search to the todo list
hints: Start from list(): search is list() plus two more filters.
Compare lowercase versions of both the title and the query, and trim the query first.
Return copies the way list() does, so callers can't change the stored todos.

hiddenTestRules.search > matches part of the title, igno: Return the todos whose title contains query, ignoring upper/lower case.
hiddenTestRules.search > returns everything for an empty: An empty query matches every todo.
hiddenTestRules.search > filters by tag, ignoring case: options.tag (optional): only todos that have this exact tag, ignoring case
hiddenTestRules.search > combines the query and the tag: options.tag (optional): only todos that have this exact tag, ignoring case
hiddenTestRules.search > filters by status like list(): options.status (optional): 'all' (default), 'open' or 'done', the same as list().
hiddenTestRules.search > returns an empty list when noth: Return the todos whose title contains query, ignoring upper/lower case.
hiddenTestRules.search > returns copies, tags included: Like list(), return copies: changing a result must not change the stored todo.
